уехать.gloss: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (root 'ехать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to leave', forming an aspectual pair with 'уезжать'.

examples.text: Ей надо уехать, чтобы не мучить никого.

meanings.note: Coordinating or subordinating Russian conjunction meaning 'so that', linking clauses in spoken dialogue.

meanings.en: to force, to make (someone do something)
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'ставлять'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to force', forming an aspectual pair with 'заставить'.
